name: Confusing Critical (Combat, Critical)
body:
Your critical hits cause confusion in your opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Staggering Critical, base attack bonus +17.

Benefit(s): Whenever you score a critical hit, your opponent becomes confused for 1d4 rounds. A successful Fortitude save reduces the duration to 1 round. The DC of this Fortitude save is equal to 10 + your base attack bonus. The effects of this feat do not stack. Additional hits instead add to the duration.

Special: You can only apply the effects of one critical feat to a given critical hit unless you possess Critical Mastery.
